_doc: The Tactical Mind (AI-2, MONSTERS AND MAGIC, 2026-11-20): how a thinking creature weighs its turn. src/tactics.py scores the options from what the creature can see (pure); src/tactical_mind.py builds that view and carries the choice out with the moves the game already has (packs.hold_step / round_path / choose_spot, senses' paths, the ranged step back). A plain attack, or anything the mind does not plan, is today's code. Beasts, vermin and the mindless have no mind. Named foes, allies, encounter people, the unicorn, Death and Old Nickel never think here. Lines are filled by monster.fill: {The} {the} {He} {he} {him} {his}; {pet} is the pet's name, {hazard} what lies on the floor. Each option's line is said once a fight for the creature's side.

focus._doc: Go for the Weak One: a pet under pet_below of its health, within reach tiles and in sight, while the hero is above hero_above; at most share of the creatures that can see the pet go for it. Never an escort, the unicorn, a ridden Bococho or Dad.

feint._doc: Feigned Flight: once a band a floor, a soldier at a corridor's mouth falls back `back` tiles into the room while at least `need` of his band wait beside the mouth out of the hero's sight; a hero who steps out within `turns` turns is struck by each of them, hit_bonus easier to land.

cunning.name: Cunning
cunning.bestiary: Cunning: it waits for its friends, will not follow you into a corridor, and goes for whoever is bleeding.

soldier.name: Soldier
soldier.bestiary: A drilled soldier: it holds a line, changes places when the front man tires, and may feign flight to draw you out.

trickster.name: Trickster
trickster.bestiary: Tricky: it slips round to your side and will not be drawn into a corridor.

caster.name: Caster
caster.bestiary: It keeps its distance behind its friends and casts.

flags.dark_edge: It fights from the edge of your light, and steps back into the dark after it strikes.
flags.knows_traps: It fights from behind its own snares and the floor's hazards, and never steps on them.
flags.archer: An archer: it steps aside for a clear shot past its friends and keeps its distance.

lines.hold_choke: {The} and the others hang back from the narrow way.
lines.hold_choke_alone: {The} hangs back from the narrow way.
lines.round: {The} slips away to come at you from another side.
lines.wait_allies: {The} hangs back, waiting for the others to come up.
lines.flank: {The} slips round to come at you from the side.
lines.leave_light: {The} melts back into the dark at the edge of your light.
lines.hold_door: {The} backs into the doorway, to fight you one at a time.
lines.rotate: {The} steps back, and a fresh fighter takes {his} place.
lines.feint_known: {The} falls back too neatly: a feint!
lines.feint_sprung: A trick! The rest were waiting beside the way out!
lines.focus_pet: {The} sees that {pet} is hurt, and goes for the kill!
lines.press: {The} and the others see you are hurt, and press in.
lines.bait: {The} grins and waits on the far side of the {hazard}.
lines.bait_hidden: {The} waits very still, daring you to come straight at {him}.
lines.lane: {The} slips aside for a clear shot.
lines.habit_choke_fighter: {The} and the others know your corridor trick: they stay put.
lines.habit_opens_with_area: {The} and the others spread out, wary of your blasts.
lines.habit_kiter: {The} and the others close fast, wise to your hit and run.
lines.habit_rester_near_foes: {The} and the others rush you as you rest!

orders._doc: The Captain's Orders: a band's leader, while he lives, sees the hero and can shout, gives the band an order: screen (guards stand between the hero and him, shooters loose from behind them, casters hang back), charge (the hero is under charge_below of his health or held: everyone presses in), fall_back (half the band is down, once: the rest gather round him for fall_back_turns turns). Silenced, held, frightened, charmed, confused, babbled or asleep, he gives none. A hero with wax in his ears sees him shout but hears no words; the band still obeys.
orders.unseen: Somewhere ahead, a voice barks orders.
orders.wax: {The} shouts something, but the wax keeps out the words.

default.charge: {The} roars: "Now, while the hero bleeds! All of you!"
default.fall_back: {The} shouts: "Fall back! Fall back to me!"

goblin_scouts.screen: {The} snarls: "Stay in front of me, you maggots!"
goblin_scouts.charge: {The} snarls: "Get in there! The hero's bleeding!"
goblin_scouts.fall_back: {The} snarls: "Back! Back to me, you cowards!"

gnoll_pack.screen: {The} barks a laugh, and the pack spreads out before {him}.
gnoll_pack.charge: {The} howls, and the whole pack rushes in for the kill!
gnoll_pack.fall_back: {The} yelps, and the pack falls back round {him}.

bandit_crew.screen: {The} calls out: "Hold the line, lads! Bows, take your shots!"
bandit_crew.charge: {The} shouts: "The hero's done for! Finish it!"

cult_circle.fall_back: {The} cries: "To me, faithful! Close the circle!"

necro_procession.screen: {The} points, and {his} dead shuffle between you and {him}.
necro_procession.charge: {The} hisses a word, and {his} dead lurch forward together!
necro_procession.fall_back: {The} beckons, and {his} dead fall back round {him}.

fae_hunt.screen: {The} sings out, and the hunt spreads before {him}.
fae_hunt.charge: {The} sings out, and the whole hunt rushes in!
fae_hunt.fall_back: {The} calls, and the hunt melts back round {him}.

demon_warband.screen: {The} bellows, and the devils make a wall of horns.
demon_warband.fall_back: {The} bellows, and the devils gather round {him}.

habits._doc: They Learn Your Tricks: what a creature SAW the hero do on this floor (it saw him at the time), kept on the witness, and told to its war-band or pack while they hear it (a mate awake within 12 tiles); it dies with the witness. A habit counts the times it was seen, each at least `apart` turns after the last, and only the last `memory` turns. At `choke_fighter` 2 it holds its room harder; at `opens_with_area` 1 it spreads out; at `kiter` 2 (a shot from afar, then a step back) it no longer waits to be shot; at `rester_near_foes` 2 it rushes a resting hero.

ranges._doc: Archers Find a Lane: how far each MISSILE reaches (wards.is_missile: a thing shot or thrown), by the first word of `missiles` its name holds (an attack's own `range` comes first). By lore: a longbow outshoots a bow, a bow a sling or a dart; a giant's hurled boulder outreaches a sling, and Polyphemus's crag, hurled out to sea after Odysseus, outreaches them all. Everything else (a breath, a gaze, a voice, a spit, a spell, and any missile not named here) reaches `default`, as every distance attack did before.

lanes._doc: An archer whose shot is blocked looks for a lane: a free tile it can reach in `steps` steps, `min_range` to its reach from the hero and not beside him, with a clear shot; it likes `ideal` tiles off best, a tile beside a wall or a tall fixture (cover), and one out of the hero's sight. Beside the hero it steps back when it has such a tile, at most `backs` times running, then fights. With no shot and no lane it comes on, but stops `stop_at` tiles off.

queue._doc: Wait Your Turn: a hunter takes a way round only if it is at most `slack` steps longer than the straight way; stuck behind one of its own side in a narrow way it waits `wait` turns before it looks for another way.
